frame: Lesson Scroll 1 — reached the designed way
note: F20: a pushed screen can lose its SVG paint to the copy expo-router leaves mounted underneath at display:none, and a signature diff cannot see it. coverL1.tsx used to hard-code cs-win / cs-glass2 / cs-sh1b / cs-lampb / cs-sh2b; it now derives every id from useId(), so a second mount cannot steal the paint. Captured both ways and the two PNGs are identical to 0 px at threshold 6.

The same driver works for every lesson; the page count differs, so read the hairline back rather than counting taps. Used here on lesson 5 page 17 (a pick board) and page 21 (a task-options board) to prove the generator fixes beyond lesson one. There is no Email-Login frame for these, so they are not audit rows — recorded so the next pass does not rediscover the path.

unreachable: not a screen. Any frame whose diff is ~6.9k px concentrated in tiles (0,768) and (0,832) is this, not a defect: wait for Metro to settle and re-capture. Hit p8 and p12 of this group's own sweep.

frame: measurement tooling written for this group
unreachable: not a screen. .overhaul/lsdrive/pxdiff.mjs <design> <app> [thr] [--worst] [--out] — whole-frame pixel comparison; it excludes ONLY the top 54 pt (the status-bar chrome the app never builds, D009) and nothing else: no flatness test and no gradient skip, so it can see a wash (F35). .overhaul/fls/rectdiff.mjs <design> <app> <x> <y> <w> <h> [thr] measures one stated rectangle in frame points with no exclusions at all, which is how each finding here was measured where it lives. .overhaul/fls/rectwhere.mjs prints the differing columns and rows of that rectangle, which is how a one-device-pixel edge (D083) is told from a wrong area. .overhaul/fls/col.mjs walks a row or column of both images side by side. .overhaul/fls/sweep.sh captures and diffs all 26 pages in one run.
